migration.existing_stage1_save_policy: if CX10 core is valid but Day-Care flag is clear, initialize only the 18 new Day-Care bytes and set the flag

implemented_paths: Day-Care Man deposit: selected party sidecar -> persistent DayCare entry 0 before party removal
Day-Care Lady deposit: selected party sidecar -> persistent DayCare entry 1 before party removal
Day-Care Man withdraw: entry 0 -> newly appended party sidecar then clear entry 0
Day-Care Lady withdraw: entry 1 -> newly appended party sidecar then clear entry 1
